_help.response_format: Default offered at startup: text prints JSON output; audio plays the server's WAV response.
_help.api_key: Leave this empty if the local server does not require an API key.
_help.wake_word: The wake-word model stored in the models directory. Available models include hey_jarvis, alexa, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy, timer, and weather.
_help.device: Use pipewire so the client records from PipeWire's default input and converts it to 16 kHz mono. Select the physical microphone with: wpctl set-default SOURCE_ID.
_help.threshold: Wake-word detection sensitivity from 0.0 to 1.0. Lower values trigger more easily but may cause false detections; higher values reduce false detections but may be harder to trigger. Start with 0.5.
_help.silence_seconds: Seconds of continuous silence before sending audio. Increase this if natural pauses cut off your question.
_help.silence_multiplier: Speech threshold relative to calibrated ambient noise. Lower this if quiet speech is treated as silence.
_help.min_silence_rms: Minimum RMS speech threshold. Lower this if the microphone signal or your voice is quiet.
_help.timeout: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the server to respond to each request. A value of 180 means three minutes.
